# Data Dictionary

This document describes every column in the datasets used by the project. It clarifies whether the data is **Real** (sourced or directly derived from the UCI Online Retail II dataset) or **Generated** (created by a specific process or rule).

## 1. `forecasts.csv` (Generated by `make_data.py`)
| Column | Type | Real/Generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | String | Real (UCI) | The unique StockCode of the product. |
| `predicted_demand` | Float | Generated (NN) | The Neural Network's forecasted demand (in units) for the next week. |
| `last_week_demand` | Float | Real (UCI) | The actual aggregated demand (in units) for the most recent week in the dataset. |

## 2. `copurchase_pairs.csv` (Generated by `make_data.py`)
| Column | Type | Real/Generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_a` | String | Real (UCI) | The first product (StockCode) in the co-purchase pair. |
| `product_b` | String | Real (UCI) | The second product (StockCode) in the co-purchase pair. |
| `strength` | Float | Real (UCI) | The number of times these two products were bought on the same invoice during the training period. |
| `max_distance` | Integer | Generated (Rule) | The maximum allowed Manhattan distance between the two products in the warehouse (values: 2, 4, or 6). Derived from the `strength` quantiles (75th and 40th percentiles). |

## 3. `test_orders.csv` (Generated by `make_data.py`)
| Column | Type | Real/Generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Invoice` | String | Real (UCI) | The unique invoice ID for the transaction. |
| `StockCode` | String | Real (UCI) | The product ID included in the invoice (filtered to the top 120 products). |

## 4. Simulated Warehouse Attributes (Generated in `src/warehouse.py`)
These columns are **not** in the UCI data. They are generated using a fixed seed (`SEED=42`) to simulate warehouse constraints.
| Attribute | Type | Real/Generated | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | String | Generated (Simulated) | Product category (Food, Cleaning, Stationery, Fragile). Assigned randomly with seed 42. |
| `heavy` | Boolean | Generated (Simulated) | Flags if a product is heavy (True ~15% of products). Heavy items must be placed on low shelves. |
| `required_capacity` | Integer | Generated (Simulated) | The space the product requires (between 1 and 80). |
